title: Distribution surfaces register (shadow mode)
description: M3 batch 3 (T6). Shadow register, not authoritative. See docs/operations/distribution-registry.md and this file's own authority_active field. The Notion Distribution Registry stays the authority until the founder-gated M4 cutover.

authority_active.description: Always false in this batch and until the founder-gated M4 cutover. The Notion Distribution Registry stays the authority until then.

surface.description: Display name of the distribution surface.

target.description: The repository, registry or site this row is about.

status_date.description: The date the evidence shows this status, not the date this row was written.

evidence.description: A URL or a repository path that proves the status. Repository paths are checked for existence by npm run distribution:check; URLs are format-checked only.
